h1: Payment provider setup, connected and tested
overview: A billing system is only as good as its connection to your payment provider. We configure your Stripe, Paddle or similar account, create the keys your app needs, store them safely, add webhooks so your app hears about payments and cancellations, and run test payments in test mode. You get a short checklist of what is switched on, ready for the step where you go live.

pkgs.blurb: Your account connected to your app in test mode.
Webhooks for all key events and a go-live checklist.
Test and live setup with monitoring and a recovery guide.

faq: Do you need my payment provider login?
No. You add us as a team member with a limited role, or create restricted API keys. You stay the owner of the account, and can remove our access when we finish.
Can you open the account for me?
No. Account opening includes identity and business checks that only you, as the owner, can complete. We guide you through each step and set up everything after it is approved.
Will you switch my account to live mode?
We prepare it and give you the checklist. You press the final switch yourself, or we do it together on a call, so that real payments start only when you are ready.
What if my provider is not Stripe?
We also work with Paddle, Lemon Squeezy and PayPal. If you use another, tell us in the order form. We check that it has an API and webhooks before you pay.
